# player_vs_archetype_v1 — opponent-archetype screening report

*Generated by interactions_lab.py (shared pass); 200 permutations per test; runtime 273s total.*

## Protocol (as registered)

- Five opponent-archetype axes (rotation height last-10, own-3PA EWMA, blocks-per-paint-attempt-faced EWMA, steals-per-def-possession EWMA, pace EWMA — all shifted, alpha 0.10) + walk-forward-median composites TALL_SHOOTERS and SMALL_PRESSURE (features/archetypes.py).
- Level-2: own-trait x axis on mechanism channels (25 tests); null = 200 within-season TEAM-block permutations of the archetype assignment; BH at 10% as its OWN family (separate from protocol 1).
- Level-3: EB individual slopes on the two composites x 4 channels, trait-predicted slope from [own height, rim share, 3PA rate, transition share]; same shrinkage machinery and time-split naming gates as protocol 1 (see its REPORT.md pinned decisions — shared).

- Composite base rates over team-games (as-of, NaN excluded): {'TALL_SHOOTERS': 0.226, 'SMALL_PRESSURE': 0.248}.
